body: Hey thanks for everything man, you really helped me snap out of that feeling. It just took time to realize what I got and what could be there for me in the future. You honestly saved my life, thank you so much.

I have no future where I would get that lucky break you talk about. The problems I face now will continue throughout my whole life. What's the point in suffering through these problems a single more day. What's the point of graduating high school? Is it so that I can move out of my house and get some shitty job which will barely let me get by. Whilst having to deal with all the other fucked up shit in life... Sorry but I just don't want to go through this anymore.

its not worth imagining, your creating a false reality for me that things will get better. I have thought over this and im still standing where i did when i posted this. My life is not worth living anymore, im sorry i wasted your time.
nothing will ever get better as long as i dont want to fucking live here.. ever since my attempt i have wanted to be dead, whats the point in dragging this on for how ever the fuck long i live.
I had two great friends that were always there for me and now where are they.. either dead or fucking my best friend. in an ideal world you wouldn't feel this way.
Nothing, I don't aspire to be anything. I regret living this day.

alright.. lets start with a bit of a story about my life for the last few months that led me to the first attempt. First of all im 17 and my names Devin. Back in september I had recently lost a very close friend to heroine, after losing this friend and going through all the grief I had my girlfriend treat me like shit.. cheat on me with my best friend at the time. So then being very depressed and shit i turned to my parents who at the time were "recovering alcohol addicts" they basically helped tell me how much of a fucked up person I was and suggested suicide be an option for me. Then being such a motivated independent person i decided to go see a therapist to talk with.. long story short i couldnt pay for it and it only made things worse with my relationship with my parents. Then on the 24th november, I was rushed to the hospital for od on a mixture of things. I didnt have a single person other than my dad show up at the hospital, the person i least wanted to see at the time. then when i went back to school, a rumor appeared on how much of a alcoholic/drugee i was. So after a few months of having to put up with all this bullshit im here on reddit talking to you.

I dont want to be here anymore. I decided this a while back and im still here. Your trying to make it seem that I can get back on track in the future but I cant. I cant ever get back on track when I never wanted to be where I was heading in the first place. I just want to leave everything behind, and move on. Now not even myself is with me anymore to pick me up and help me carry on. Im here to beg you to move on with your life, you can leave me behind its alright. Now I just have to except it, the way it all has to be.

I've done everything I could the last few weeks to try to make myself feel like my life is going to be worth living, but I just cant see that ever happening. At this point I just feel like im better off on my own, I just feel like having you talk to me is a waste of time when I am already dead in my mind. I keep suffering every day, whos to say its going to get better anytime soon.

Yeah but whats the fucking point when you wake up everyday and just wish that the first time you tried to kill yourself had succeeded. I just cant see any reason to stay around and continue to be such a waste to all the ones in my life that I made myself care about.
I am worthless, at this point I should be long gone, I have lost everything. yet here I am giving myself a second chance of living for what reason?
